history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that the rental charge is an accurate representation of current market rates in each location.
history.administration_response: The Administration continues to endeavour to implement the recommendation by the target date indicated. A working group on rental practices was established in November 2017, and the data collection phase of the “as-is” practices at United Nations Headquarters, offices away from Headquarters and regional commissions was completed in March 2018. A report of the working group was to have been issued in June 2018 for consideration by management, and completion of the implementation was expected soon thereafter.
history.board_assessment: The Board acknowledges the actions taken by the Administration in forming a working group on rental practices. As the report of the working group is expected soon, the recommendation is considered to be under implementation.

Please note that the market survey for rental charges was performed for the main United Nations duty stations in New York, Geneva, Nairobi, Bangkok, Santiago and Addis Ababa. It should be noted that United Nations Office at Vienna and the Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia (ESCWA) offices and facilities are provided by host countries and do not have lease-out processes. Therefore, the United Nations Office at Vienna and ESCWA were not requested to conduct market surveys. The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Administration finished the survey and updated the memorandum of understanding, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
